title: An overall deadline
hints: time.After(d) inside the loop creates a new timer every iteration. Each value that arrives restarts the clock, so a steady stream of values means it never fires.
Create the timer once, before the loop, and select on that same channel every time.
deadline := time.After(d); for { select { case v := <-ch: out = append(out, v); case <-deadline: return out } }
